newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM shares sought on copper recovery.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM shares sought on copper recovery.

text.p: Mining house MIM Holdings Ltd topped the local share market turnover list on Tuesday as institutional investors took a positive view of the stock due to the rising copper price and its Ernest Henry operations.
About 22.7 million shares in MIM were traded, with the stock ending steady at A$1.79.

Phil Hutchings, the director of resources research at Brisbane broker Wilson HTM, said the activity in MIM was due to the recovery in the copper price after reaching 80 US cent lows, as well as a recent tour of the Ernest Henry copper/gold project in Queensland which impressed analysts.
MIM spokesman Collin Myers said he had no comment on Tuesday's trade.

The head of an institutional dealing desk in Sydney said the MIM turnover was due to a recent positive re-rating of the stock, led by the copper price and a roadshow presentation by MIM chief executive Nick Stump to U.S. investors.
"There is nothing suspicious in it (the turnover)," he said.
